beats.text: Hanuman lit a sacred fire. Rama and Sugriva walked around it together and sealed their friendship. 'Your joy is my joy,' Rama said. 'Your sorrow is my sorrow.'
Sugriva told his story. His brother Vali, king of Kishkindha, had driven him out, taken his kingdom and his wife Ruma.
Once, Vali had chased a demon into a cave, and Sugriva waited outside for a year. When blood flowed out, he thought Vali was dead, and sealed the cave.
But Vali returned alive, and never forgave him. 'Help me,' Sugriva said, 'and my army will find Sita.'
Then Sugriva showed him the jewels Sita had dropped as she was carried away, wrapped in her yellow scarf.
Lakshmana said: 'I do not know her earrings or bracelets. I only ever looked at her feet. These anklets are hers.'
